title: Product Sales Specialist - Digital Radiography (DR)
description:
Who we are?

United Imaging is a leading global medical device developer and supplier with a diversified portfolio of advanced medical products, digital healthcare solutions, and intelligent solutions that cover the entire process of imaging diagnosis and treatment. From our North American HQ in Houston, we are passionate about expanding our customer sales and support structure, embracing the highest quality and craftsmanship in each of our medical imaging products, and dedicated to building an outstanding organization.

Join our innovative team with the mission of developing and supplying advanced technologies and improving patient care worldwide. As part of our global team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues while developing and expanding your career.

Company Page: http://www.united-imaging.com/en/home/

Benefits and Compensation

When joining our team, we offer the following benefits: medical, dental, vision, short- & long-term disability insurance, employee assistance program, company paid basic life insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, sick leave, and (12) paid holidays. Compensation decisions are based upon the candidate level of skill, qualifications, geographical location and experience, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the posted pay range. Additionally, the position may also be eligible to earn performance-based incentive compensation (such as cash bonus(es).

Job Summary

We are seeking a passionate and driven member for the Digital Radiography (DR) team that is trusted and empowered to make rapid decisions for the mutual benefit of our customers and the company. A DR Modality Manager candidate is being sought to manage the modality business within given regions and partners in the United States. The DR Modality Manager will be working with local account executives and partner teams to support the provision of our DR portfolio to health systems, hospitals, and diagnostic imaging centers. The successful candidate will demonstrate the characteristics of authenticity and integrity that are needed to build meaningful and lasting relationships with both our internal and external customers. The DR Modality Manager will serve as the technical product expert for clients as they consider the United Imaging DR products and services. Humility, energy, work ethic, and a focus on quality are all important qualities for this role as we build a strong culture of ownership and empowerment.

Must be Located:  West Coast region

Main Responsibilities

• Maintain deep domain expertise in healthcare as pertaining to the DR modality, including market and competitive intelligence.

• Develop business strategy for modality products within a given region, leveraging the United Imaging portfolio to meet market potential.

• Establish the United Imaging modality brand within the region, growing the installed base and reputation by delighting customers    with superior customer orientation.

• Support account executives from United Imaging and partners with both proven and creative strategy, product knowledge, clinical    motivators, and business insight to advance sales opportunities.

• Develop and maintain an understanding of the unique customer needs (clinical, operational, financial) that are specific to a    given customer’s environment.

• Be the “voice of the customer” to present their perspective and needs as related to the planning, evaluation, purchasing, and clinical usage of the modality.

• Consult and present for customers on product offerings and guide them through the sales process.

• Cultivate and maintain relationships with clients that have influence in DR equipment decisions, including radiologists, radiology    managers, and technologists.

• Achieve sales quota for your assigned territory.

• Support the account team with a strategy to develop and maintain a qualified sales funnel to ensure over-achievement.

• Engage and leverage the internal support team to advance sales projects through product knowledge, clinical demonstrations, and customer installed base references.

• Develop and maintain regional customer references and a regional installed base that is delighted with United Imaging products.

Note: Other duties as assigned.

• Candidates have 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience within DR (or related) sales role.

• Demonstration of technical, clinical, operational, and financial knowledge pertaining to the DR market.

• Successful track record of meeting and exceeding sales goals.

• Demonstration of a strong customer orientation, high energy and motivation, and willingness to travel within territory.

Job Overview:

As an Ultrasound Applications Specialist (GI Ultrasound), you will serve as the clinical expert and trusted advisor for United Imaging's ultrasound portfolio, partnering with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional end-to-end clinical experience. You will play a critical role in driving product adoption, optimizing clinical workflows, and ensuring customers realize the full value of their ultrasound investment throughout the product lifecycle.

As part of a rapidly growing ultrasound business, you'll have the opportunity to influence customer success, shape product adoption, and contribute directly to the evolution of next-generation ultrasound technologies. We're looking for a clinically experienced professional with strong business acumen, an entrepreneurial mindset, and a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences. The ideal candidate is adaptable, solutions-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where collaboration, initiative, and continuous improvement are key to success.

Please apply only if you currently reside in the Central Florida area.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Success & Clinical Excellence:

• Serve as the clinical expert and trusted advisor for United Imaging's ultrasound portfolio, delivering an exceptional end-to-end customer experience throughout the product lifecycle.

• Drive clinical adoption, workflow optimization, and long-term utilization of ultrasound solutions to maximize customer satisfaction and loyalty.

• Assess customer education needs and deliver tailored clinical training that enables users to achieve optimal clinical and operational outcomes.

• Serve as the primary clinical resource for customer inquiries and escalations, ensuring timely resolution in collaboration with internal teams.

• Capture and communicate Voice of the Customer (VOC) insights to support continuous product improvement and enhanced customer experience.

Sales & Commercial Support:

• Partner with Account Executives and Modality Managers to support territory growth through clinical expertise, product demonstrations, and strategic customer engagement.

• Provide pre-sales and post-sales clinical support to help achieve territory revenue, order, and market share objectives.

• Conduct onsite and virtual product demonstrations throughout the assigned territory and support opportunities across other regions as needed.

• Represent United Imaging at trade shows, customer workshops, conferences, and other educational events.

• Identify customer opportunities and market insights that support business growth and strengthen customer relationships.

Job Description

We are seeking ambitious Ultrasound Engineers to contribute to the design, development, and optimization of imaging modes and features for our ultrasound imaging platforms. This position could be opened at multiple levels including Principal, Lead, and Senior depending upon years of experience in relation to posted requirements. As the Lead Ultrasound Engineer, you are responsible for ensuring world-class imaging performance on our products that meet our customers’ needs. You will integrate a range of transducers onto ultrasound imaging platforms and assess clinical value. You will develop software tools, image and data analytics infrastructure, and test methods to facilitate pre-clinical and clinical evaluation. You will regularly collaborate with a global, cross-functional team that includes Product Managers, Clinical Application Specialists, and R&D colleagues (e.g., hardware, software, mechanical, and transducer engineers).

• Develop and improve features in echocardiography, including 3D/4D volumetric imaging

• Design and develop the full ultrasound signal path (from transmit to display) for basic imaging modes and advanced features

• Lead image performance improvement, including algorithm research and development, pre-clinical and clinical image optimization, verification and validation

•  Lead new product development activities, including design requirements and specifications, test method development, verification, and related documentation that complies with medical device regulations, standards, and our quality system

• Collaborate with global Ultrasound team to integrate transducers onto ultrasound platforms
